conferences.name: UN Global Dialogue on AI Governance (Geneva)
conferences.desc: The UN's first Global Dialogue on AI Governance (6-7 July), established under the Global Digital Compact and attended by all 193 member states, running alongside the ITU AI for Good Global Summit and the WSIS+20 Forum (7-10 July). The first universal, intergovernmental venue for AI governance, with children's safety, youth participation, the AI divide, and future-generations equity recurring across opening statements and the Independent Scientific Panel's first assessment.
